title: The Stage 0 limits from healthy arrays of three laboratories
set_out: Set Stage 0's control-probe limits from healthy EPIC v1 arrays of three laboratories with the corrected measurements, then score every blood cell in whole blood and finish the documentation pass.
open_at_turnover: Open: the self-tare test on real arrays (GRP-014); the 3D sphere's textures on GitHub (step 13).

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Stage 0's control-probe limits set from 337 healthy arrays (GRP-004, PROC-STAGE0-04)
entries.what: The bisulfite, hybridization and extension controls of 337 healthy whole-blood arrays from three laboratories, read with the corrected Stage 0 on GitHub. The limits are now set from them: bisulfite conversion at least 0.80 (the author's choice, the 2.5th percentile with each laboratory counted equally), hybridization spread at least 2.0, extension balance 0.2 to 5.0. One healthy array is stopped, a real low conversion; the rest pass.
entries.why: A check that refuses a sample has to be set from what healthy samples actually look like, in more than one laboratory.

entries.title: The self-tare on real arrays (GRP-014, DEV-SELFTARE-03)
entries.what: On 55 real healthy bloods the self-tare removes a 1 % loss of the neutrophils' pattern that reaches every site, and keeps the same loss at the identity sites. A version that keeps it fails the replicate and other-laboratory bars, so the commissioned self-tare stays. The number it corrects each array by carries that loss and becomes the next reading to build.
entries.why: A real loss of held marks may reach every site; the reading must not erase it.

entries.title: The two healthy references compared (ATL-070)
entries.what: IAM-Atlas v2.1 and Met-A's purified-array reference agree closely value by value, but the atlas sits slightly closer to 0.5 at nearly every site, so Met-A read on the atlas neutrophil gives 1.062. Met-A keeps its own reference.
entries.why: Two references made different ways are not interchangeable on an entropy reading.

entries.title: Hard-to-map regions against our instruments (OTH-079)
entries.what: Of the array's probes, 3.14 % cannot be placed uniquely in the genome; every instrument's sites fall on them less often (0.86 to 1.90 %). A re-read without them runs on GitHub. Result: Met-A and the cell shares did not move (at most 0.002); the C-Score moved only by its own repeat noise. The mask is not needed.
entries.why: A probe that reads two near-identical places mixes their signals.

entries.title: The IAM-A commissioning note describes its CD8 study by its work (OTH-072)
entries.what: The note names the study by its accession and what it measured, not by its laboratory.
entries.why: Public text describes a reference by its work.
